caption: Add sessions, lower the limit, then press Crash worker to watch the journal recover them.

realDefaults: ejm-harness defaults allow 8 model requests, 4 local jobs and 1 heavy job. The sliders here use sample values.

langs.code:
from ejm_harness import Harness

with Harness(config={"state_dir": ".ejm-harness"}) as harness:
    session = harness.create_session(".")
    run = session.start("Hello")
    for event in run:
        if event["type"] == "text_delta":
            print(event["text"], end="", flush=True)
    result = run.wait()
